newsitem.title: FRANCE: 2nd Frenchman snared in paedophilia net kills self.
newsitem.headline: 2nd Frenchman snared in paedophilia net kills self.

text.p: A second man snared in France's biggest ever crackdown on paedophiles has committed suicide, police said on Friday.
They said the unnamed 48-year-old bachelor, an executive at an arms factory in the central town of Tulle, hanged himself at his home on Thursday.

A postal inspector in his 40s was found hanged at his home in the eastern town of Saint-Martin-d'Heres on Thursday after police questioned him about pornographic materials at his home. He had left a suicide note, police officials said.

The two men were among more than 630 people rounded up this week in swoops across the country round on clients of a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.
The dead man in Tulle was among 210 people formally placed under investigation on suspicion of "being in possession of images showing the corruption of minors aged under 15".
Of these, 18 have been remanded in custody, including the suspected ringleader, Bernard Alapetite, the 47-year-old head of a Paris publishing house.
Police said Alapetite copied foreign child sex videos and sold them for 800 francs ($140) each.

The operation -- dubbed "Ado 71" after the French word for teenager and the car registration figure for the Macon region -- involved some 2,500 gendarmes across mainland France as well as on the French Caribbean islands of Martinique and Guadeloupe.
